artifact.question: Is the assay noise floor measurable on an endpoint-HOMOGENEOUS axis of the frozen GLP-1R pin?

replicateRule.definition: same canonicalSmiles + same standardType + >= 2 DISTINCT assayId
replicateRule.whyDistinctAssaysIsRequired: two rows from ONE assay are a duplicated record, not an independent repeat. Counting them yields a spread near zero and therefore a falsely LOW noise floor — the dangerous direction, because it makes the data look more reliable than it is.
replicateRule.whySameEndpointIsRequired: EC50 (functional potency) and IC50/Ki (binding) are different physical quantities. D-089 measured their median disagreement at 1.7618 pActivity across 65 molecules; treating that as noise produced a spurious floor of 1.1212, recorded WITHDRAWN in the D-089 seal.

assayIdProvenanceVerification.method: measured directly on the frozen pin, not assumed
assayIdProvenanceVerification.consequence: on THIS pin the distinct-assay condition is currently REDUNDANT: no molecule repeats within one assay, so >=2 records already implies >=2 assays. The condition is retained because that redundancy is a property of today's data, not of the rule — bulk sources routinely carry several rows per assay, and the first extension would make it load-bearing. A guard that is currently inert is not a guard that is unnecessary.

measurements.reconcilesWith: the aggregate of 6 sealed in D-089 Diagnostic-0 (artifactHash dd782ef2a4bab906a0b5869242861a84)

result.statement: The assay noise floor cannot be measured from this pin on ANY endpoint axis. The EC50 axis — the one that would matter, being both the largest and the homogeneous one — carries 4 replicate groups against a floor of 20.
result.implementationIndependent: This outcome does not depend on the quality of any grouping implementation. The data physically contains 6 repeat measurements in total; no rule recovers a floor from that.

consequenceForTheResearchQuestion.question: Can the D-088 V2 ceiling (MAE 1.0425) be scientifically improved under frozen rules?
consequenceForTheResearchQuestion.answer: UNDECIDABLE FROM THIS PIN. Deciding it requires knowing how much of the error is irreducible label noise, and that quantity is NOT_MEASURED. D-089's CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT therefore stands unchanged and is NOT upgraded to an impossibility claim.
consequenceForTheResearchQuestion.whatWouldDecideIt: endpoint-homogeneous EC50-only human GLP-1R rows on new Murcko scaffolds — the same acquisition that lifts the size floor also creates the replicate groups that make the noise floor measurable. One acquisition answers both open questions.
